tool.help:
**DrugCLIP: Deep Contrastive Learning for Virtual Screening**
DrugCLIP enables genome-wide virtual screening up to 10 million times faster than traditional docking.
**How it works:** Uses contrastive learning to match protein binding pockets with small molecules in a shared embedding space.
**Inputs:** - Target protein pocket structure (PDB/MOL2) - Compound library (SMILES format)
**Outputs:** - Ranked list of top hits with scores
**Performance:** - Screens millions of compounds in minutes - Comparable accuracy to physics-based docking
**Citation:** Gao et al. (2025). Deep contrastive learning enables genome-wide virtual screening. Science. DOI: 10.1126/science.ads9530
